caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular cabinet with a decorative arch on top and sits on four short, curved legs. The cabinet is predominantly painted in light beige or off-white, with green, red, and yellow floral and vine patterns embellishing the front and side panels. The front door of the cabinet is wooden brown with visible wood grain texture and is fitted with two metal hinges and a latch, all rendered in a dark brown shade. The door is set within an arched frame, above which there is a green, leafy motif. The floral designs on the cabinet include stylized flowers and leaves in red, yellow, and green, with the patterns bordered in red. The overall composition centers the cabinet against a plain, cream-colored background without additional objects or details.
title: Altar Tabernacle
